items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Anyway, I subbed for Pepper in the Thad Jones band, and the subbing consisted of about maybe two and a half or three years before he finally came back.

ctx.x: Well that came about when I used to sub sometimes for Pepper. And around, I think it was around ‘68, somewhere around there, ‘68 or ‘69, Pepper’s mother got very sick. And he decided that he wanted to go back to Detroit to take care of her, which I thought was a wonderful thing for anyone, and especially in his position, in mid-career. He was very © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -7-

well known and world renown, and for him to just pick up and go back to Detroit, it was a wonderful thing to do. Anyway, I subbed for Pepper in the Thad Jones band, and the subbing consisted of about maybe two and a half or three years before he finally came back. So I had a lot of great experience, and I made a wonderful record with that band called “Central Park North,” which I still listen to that record, it was a great band, it was a wonderful band.
Thad wrote some really innovative charts.
